prefeito.comoAssumiu: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, assumiu a chefia da prefeitura em 10/08/2026, depois da renúncia do vice-prefeito Sandro Roberto Del Bem, que estava no comando da prefeitura desde que a Câmara Municipal cassou o mandato do prefeito eleito em 2024, Paulo Nunes de Almeida. A eleição suplementar para prefeito e vice está marcada para 06/12/2026.
prefeito.comoAssumiu_en: As president of the City Council, he took over as head of the city government on August 10, 2026, after the resignation of Vice Mayor Sandro Roberto Del Bem, who had been running the city since the City Council removed the mayor elected in 2024, Paulo Nunes de Almeida, from office. The special election for mayor and vice mayor is scheduled for December 6, 2026.

vice.txt_en: The office of vice mayor has been vacant since August 2026, when Vice Mayor Sandro Roberto Del Bem resigned. The special election for mayor and vice mayor is scheduled for December 6, 2026.
